I will apply urea and cow manure to this rented wheat plot because the soil is tired and I need enough grain to pay the landlord and feed my family. I will use improved seed from the cooperative since it yields more than the local wheat, but I will not spend money on chemicals for pests this season. My family will work this 0.16-hectare plot for about twenty days from ploughing to threshing, and I will hire three day-laborers to help with the harvest. There is no irrigation here in Oromia, so we wait only for the rains.
